title: Phone executor: Positions/Closed read waits for the tab chips on the /trade terminal; a miss dumps where it is
note: [2026-10-13 lane, dispatched by manager session_01G16FfyYSmDPQuuW55BuTmK] positions_state=no_tab on every breakout_2 account_status since the #17793 deploy. ROOT CAUSE (from code; the live page was not inspected): (1) the no_tab path returned a bare {state:no_tab} so the miss dump's headers:[] controls:[] were an ARTEFACT of the miss object carrying no dump, not evidence the document was empty; (2) readView clicked once with no wait, but the bottom-panel chips render after readyState complete and readAccount ran right after settle()/load (background engine path bgJob: load home() -> settle(document complete) -> readAccount) gated only on terminal().ready, which other signals (order control, probe) can satisfy before the chips exist; (3) clickText only matches button/[role=tab]/[role=button]/a, so a plain div/span chip with a count badge is invisible to it. FIX: readView waits up to 12 s for __ex.tabChips(), opens terminalHref when on an account page that is not /trade (not while the operator is using the screen), clicks via clickTab (adds leaf div/span/li chips), and a genuine miss now posts state 'no_tab d<path_depth> c<chips> t<trade>' plus a masked leaf-text list and controls; server scrubs the miss state. Read-only; no order path; reconcile stays report_only, >15-row refusal untouched. landed_unproven until the APK ships and a live read returns positions_state=read. [scope add 2026-10-13 05:14Z, manager/operator 'the system opened that position, it should be aware of it'] src/prop/fill_inference.py: a journal `placed` limit is inferred filled-open (entry = limit, ESTIMATED, external_order_id inferred-<ticket>, reason INFERRED...) when 5m candles trade strictly through it after placement, and inferred closed at SL/TP by a LATER bar (both in one bar = no guess + one flag); a clean phone Positions read is the arbiter (absent -> not inferred; present -> overwritten MEASURED, never inferred closed). Hooked into the main tick via run_inference_tick (5 min, phone prop accounts). Not covered: a later clean Closed-orders read does not yet overwrite an inferred CLOSE's exit. [scope add 2026-10-13 05:42-05:59Z] CLOSED ORDERS (operator: live tab layout transcribed by the manager; screenshot not committed): readView re-reads no_table/empty_unconfirmed up to 4x after the click; clickText/clickTab scrollIntoView the clipped last chip; closed read now REQUIRES a Type/Status column (the 05:34Z closed_empty_unconfirmed was most likely the still-shown flat Positions grid matching the generic closed shape); parseRow adds reduce=true for the '(Reduce)' span; server keeps reduce, and an exit row must be Filled (cancelled/other status refused) and reduce!=false (the plain 'Short Limit' entry row is never an exit). fill_unpriced_closes now also overrides INFERRED (ESTIMATED) closes with the MEASURED exit + P&L. Inference judges placed->filled->closed in one pass. UNKNOWN: the real Closed-orders column header texts beyond Market|Side|Type; if the next live read still misses, its closed_* diag carries the masked headers + controls.
